name: Text field example - longer command-skill cooldowns
description: Multiplies every command-skill cooldown by 1.5, so a skill spends half again as long before it can be used again. The fields are the gm_param.skill_reload_N rows of App/zh/rom/gm_param.properties, which the client reads; the server does not. min stops a cooldown reaching zero, which the game would treat as ready. This is the example for the ordinary case: a text file, one field per line, value is a number. Not verified in game.
